raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.7" %}
# see github.com/conda-forge/conda-forge.github.io/issues/1059 for naming discussion
{% set torch_proc_type = "cuda" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu" %}

package:
  name: nnpops
  version: "{{ version }}"

source:
  url: https://github.com/openmm/NNPOps/archive/refs/tags/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 993e9b6701e5dd9980df155a4ffb92e4e3c616c35035995d4019b8deebbee773
  patches:
      - patches/fix-osx-lib-loading.patch  # [osx]
      - patches/cpp17.patch
build:
  skip: true  # [win]
  number: 1
  rpaths:
    - lib/
    - {{ SP_DIR }}/torch/lib
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/libcuda.*'  # [linux64]
  string: cuda{{ cuda_compiler_version | replace('.', '') }}py{{ CONDA_PY }}h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
  string: cpu_py{{ CONDA_PY }}h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}  # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]

requirements:
  build:
    - python                                 # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - cross-python_{{ target_platform }}     # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - {{ stdlib('c') }}
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    {% if cuda_compiler_version != "None" %}
    - {{ compiler('cuda') }}
    - cuda-cudart-dev
    # No cuda-driver-dev in windows
    - cuda-driver-dev  # [linux]
    - cuda-version {{ cuda_compiler_version }}
    - libcufft-dev
    - libcurand-dev
    - libcublas-dev
    - cuda-nvrtc-dev
    - cuda-nvtx-dev
    - cuda-profiler-api
    - cuda-nvrtc-dev
    - libcusparse-dev
    - libcusolver-dev
    {% endif %}
    - make
    - cmake
  host:
    - python
    - pytorch
    - pytorch * {{ torch_proc_type }}*
  run:
    - python
    - cuda-version  # [cuda_compiler_version not in (undefined, 'None')]
  run_constrained:
    # additional run constraint to the one from the (version-only) run_export;
    # constraining the CPU builds to CPU pytorch isn't 100% necessary, but cleaner
    - pytorch * {{ torch_proc_type }}*

test:
  requires:
    - mdtraj
    - pytest
    - numpy
  imports:
    - NNPOps
  commands: |
    cd ${CONDA_PREFIX}/share/nnpops/tests
    ls -al
    set +e
    summary=""
    exitcode=0
    for f in Test*.py; do
      if [[ $f == *Cuda* || $f == *OpenCL* ]]; then
        continue
      fi
      echo "Running $f..."
      pytest -v ./${f}
      thisexitcode=$?
      summary+="\n${f}: "
      if [[ $thisexitcode == 0 ]]; then summary+="OK"; else summary+="FAILED"; fi
      ((exitcode+=$thisexitcode))
    done
    echo "-------"
    echo "Summary"
    echo "-------"
    echo -e "${summary}"
    exit $exitcode

about:
  home: https://github.com/openmm/NNPOps
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: High performance implementations of operations used in Neural Network Potentials

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - raimis
    - mikemhenry
    - h-vetinari
    - RaulPPelaez
